familyOrModelDisplayName.description: The family or model name of the device to which these settings apply.

tag.description: The unique identifier for the setting.

friendlyName.description: A user-friendly name for the setting. It helps to correlate the tag with the UI in settings groups.

alert.description: Alert message related to this setting, if applicable.

level.description: The levels at which this setting can be configured. When fetching tags or updating tags, the tag should be allowed at the level the request is made for.
